title: CI Controller
text: 包括空气质量流量、扭矩和 EGR 估计的压燃式控制器，输入 11 路、输出 5 路；{EGR valve area percent, f_egrcmd} 查找表 array、{Commanded torque breakpoints, f_egr_tq_bpt} 指定断点、{Speed breakpoints, f_egr_n_bpt} 指定断点、{VGT rack position table, f_rpcmd} 查找表 array、{Commanded torque breakpoints, f_rp_tq_bpt} 指定断点、{Speed breakpoints, f_rp_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Injector slope, Sinj} 指定斜率、{Stoichiometric air-fuel ratio, afr_stoich} 指定比值、{Fuel lower heating value, fuel_lhv} 指定热量 42e6、{Fuel mass per injection table, f_fcmd_tot} 查找表 array、{Fuel main injection timing table, f_main_soi} 查找表 array、{Fuel main injection timing fuel breakpoints, f_main_soi_f_bpt} 指定断点 vector、{Fuel main injection timing speed breakpoints, f_main_soi_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Commanded torque breakpoints, f_f_tot_tq_bpt} 指定断点、{Speed breakpoints, f_f_tot_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Base idle speed, N_idle} 指定速度、{Enable torque command limit, Trq_idlecmd_enable} 指定转矩、{Maximum torque command, Trq_idlecmd_max} 指定转矩、{Proportional gain, Kp_idle} 指定 PI 控制器、{Integral gain, Ki_idle} 指定 PI 控制器、{Rev-limiter speed threshold, EngRevLim} 指定发动机转速限制、{Enable Engine Stop-Start} 以启用发动机起停逻辑、{External Enable Port} 指定创建输入端口、{Engine stop time, EngStopTime} 指定发动机停止时间、{Catalyst light off time, CatLightOffTime} 指定催化剂起燃时间、{Sample time, Ts} 指定采样时间、{Number of cylinders, NCyl} 指定发动机气缸数、{Crank revolutions per power stroke, Cps} 指定每冲程转数、{Total displaced volume, Vd} 指定体积、{Ideal gas constant air, Rair} 指定常量、{Air standard pressure, Pstd} 指定压力、{Air standard temperature, Tstd} 指定温度、{Speed density volumetric efficiency, f_nv} 查找表 array、{Speed density intake manifold pressure breakpoints, f_nv_prs_bpt} 指定断点、{Speed density engine speed breakpoints, f_nv_n_bpt} 指定断点、{EGR valve standard flow calibration, f_egr_stdflow} 查找表 array、{EGR valve standard flow pressure ratio breakpoints, f_egr_stdflow_pr_bpt} 指定断点 vector、{EGR valve standard flow area percent breakpoints, f_egr_stdflow_egrap_bpt} 指定断点 vector、{Turbocharger pressure ratio, f_turbo_pr} 查找表 array、{Turbocharger pressure ratio standard flow breakpoints, f_turbo_pr_stdflow_bpt} 指定断点 vector、{Turbocharger pressure ratio corrected speed breakpoints, f_turbo_pr_corrspd_bpt} 指定断点 vector、{Turbocharger pressure ratio VGT position correction, f_turbo_pr_vgtposcorr} 查找表 array、{Turbocharger pressure ratio VGT position correction breakpoints, f_turbo_pr_vgtposcorr_bpt} 指定断点 vector、{Torque table, f_tq_nf} 查找表 array、{Torque table fuel mass per injection breakpoints, f_tq_nf_f_bpt} 指定断点、{Torque table speed breakpoints, f_tq_nf_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Fuel mass per injection breakpoints, f_tqs_f_bpt} 指定断点 vector、{Engine speed breakpoints, f_tqs_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Optimal main start of injection timing, f_tqs_mainsoi} 指定最佳 MAINSOI array、{Optimal intake manifold gas pressure, f_tqs_map} 指定最佳进气 MAP array、{Optimal exhaust manifold gas pressure, f_tqs_emap} 指定最佳排气 MAP array、{Optimal intake manifold gas temperature, f_tqs_mat} 指定最佳进气 MAT array、{Optimal intake gas oxygen percent, f_tqs_o2pct} 指定最佳进气气体氧含量 array、{Optimal fuel rail pressure, f_tqs_fuelpress} 指定最佳燃油轨压力 array、{Optimal gross indicated mean effective pressure, f_tqs_imepg} 指定最佳平均有效压力 array、{Optimal friction mean effective pressure, f_tqs_fmep} 指定最佳摩擦平均有效压力 array、{Optimal pumping mean effective pressure, f_tqs_pmep} 指定最佳泵气平均有效压力 array、{Friction multiplier as a function of temperature, f_tqs_fric_temp_mod} 指定摩擦乘数 array、{Friction multiplier temperature breakpoints, f_tqs_fric_temp_bpt} 指定断点 vector、{Main start of injection timing efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_mainsoi_eff} 指定 MAINSOI 效率乘数 array、{Main start of injection timing relative to optimal timing breakpoints, f_tqs_mainsoi_delta_bpt} 指定断点 vector、{Intake manifold gas pressure efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_map_eff} 指定进气压力效率乘数 array、{Intake manifold gas pressure ratio relative to optimal pressure ratio breakpoints, f_tqs_map_ratio_bpt} 指定断点、{Intake manifold gas lambda breakpoints, f_tqs_lambda_bpt} 指定断点、{Intake manifold gas temperature efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_mat_eff} 指定进气温度效率乘数 array、{Intake manifold gas temperature relative to optimal gas temperature breakpoints, f_tqs_mat_delta_bpt} 指定断点、{Intake manifold gas oxygen efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_o2pct_eff} 指定进气氧效率乘数 array、{Intake gas oxygen percent relative to optimal breakpoints, f_tqs_o2pct_delta_bpt} 指定断点 vector、{Fuel rail pressure efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_fuelpress_eff} 指定效率乘数 array、{Fuel rail pressure relative to optimal breakpoints, f_tqs_fuelpress_delta_bpt} 指定断点 vector、{Fuel mass injection type identifier, f_tqs_f_inj_type} 指定类型标识符、{Indicated mean effective pressure post inject correction, f_tqs_imep_post_corr} 指定后喷射修正 array、{Indicated mean effective pressure post inject mass sum breakpoints, f_tqs_f_post_sum_bpt} 指定断点、{Indicated mean effective pressure post inject start of inject timing centroid breakpoints, f_tqs_soi_post_cent_bpt} 指定断点、{Maximum start of injection angle for burned fuel, f_tqs_f_burned_soi_limit} 指定已燃燃料的最大 SOI 角、{Exhaust gas specific heat at constant pressure, cp_exh} 指定比热、{Exhaust temperature table, f_t_exh} 查找表 array、{Fuel mass per injection breakpoints, f_t_exh_f_bpt} 指定断点、{Speed breakpoints, f_t_exh_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Optimal exhaust manifold gas temperature, f_tqs_exht} 指定最优排气歧管气体温度 array、{Main start of injection timing exhaust temperature efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_exht_mainsoi_eff} 指定主 SOI 正时效率乘数 array、{Intake manifold gas pressure exhaust temperature efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_exht_map_eff} 指定进气歧管效率乘数 array、{Intake manifold gas temperature exhaust temperature efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_exht_mat_eff} 指定进气歧管效率乘数 array、{Intake manifold gas oxygen exhaust temperature efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_exht_o2pct_eff} 指定进气歧管效率乘数 array、{Fuel rail pressure exhaust temperature efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_exht_fuelpress_eff} 指定燃油轨压力排气温度效率乘数 array、{Post-injection cylinder wall heat loss transfer coefficient, f_tqs_exht_post_inj_wall_htc} 指定后喷射偏移，按实例取值。
